1.s: Paul urges Timothy to stop false teachers. “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.”
1.d: Paul calls himself the worst of sinners as an example of Christ’s patience.

2.s: Pray for everyone, including rulers. “There is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.” Guidance on men and women in worship.
2.d: 2:11–15 on women teaching is one of the most debated passages in the New Testament.

3.s: Qualifications for overseers and deacons: above reproach, faithful in marriage, gentle, not lovers of money. An early hymn: “God was revealed in the flesh.”
3.d: The church is “the pillar and ground of the truth”.

4.s: Some will abandon the faith. “every creature of God is good.” “Let no man despise your youth; but be an example.”
4.d: Godliness is profitable for all things.

5.s: Care for widows; honour elders; don’t accept accusations without witnesses.
5.d: Practical church care for the vulnerable.

6.s: “Godliness with contentment is great gain.” “The love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.” “Fight the good fight of faith.” Command the rich to be generous.
6.d: We brought nothing into the world and can take nothing out.
